verdict.line: You lose if you stand in her Hookshot-to-Ultimatum chain at level 6+; you win if you poke with Q (Rupture) and deny her free autos before then.

brief.thesis: At 47.9% over 165 games this is a true coinflip, slightly below Cho'Gath's 51.2% baseline in the role, and the reason is structural: Camille's threat is burst gated behind E (Hookshot)'s 16/15/14/13/12s cooldown and R (The Hextech Ultimatum)'s 140/115/90s cooldown, while Cho'Gath's threat is a constant zoning tool in Q (Rupture) on a 9s cooldown plus a scaling true-damage execute in R (Feast). Whoever forces the other to act inside their own cooldown window wins the exchange.

theirWindow.when: Camille has E up near a wall
theirWindow.what: She can Hookshot off the wall and the landing knocks up any champion she lands near, opening into R (The Hextech Ultimatum) at level 6+ to anchor you in place. Pre-emptively Rupture the space she's dashing into or disengage before she reaches wall range — once she's airborne-committed you can't stop the knockup.

yourWindow.when: Her E and Q both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: With Hookshot and Precision Protocol down she has no gap-close and no empowered auto, so step in and trade Q into auto (Vorpal Spikes fires every attack on a 0.5s cooldown) into W (Feral Scream) silence if she tries to flash-engage anyway.

start.why: Run with the 46.6% win-rate, 70.1%-picked start — the extra sustain and mana let you throw Q (Rupture) pokes every cooldown without running dry, since Camille has no ranged poke to punish you for standing at 950-range Q distance.

boots.why: 52.1% win rate and the clear majority pick (53.1%) — Camille's entire kit (Q bonus damage, auto-attacks, R bonus magic damage on autos) is attack-based, and flat damage reduction blunts every auto she lands, including her passive Adaptive Defenses shield-fishing autos.

core.why: Gives you a gap-close to land Q/W/R on her the instant her Hookshot or Ultimatum cooldown expires and she tries to disengage
Omnivamp sustains you through her W (Tactical Sweep) poke phase while the empowered-damage passive scales your Feral Scream silence trades
The move-speed stack keeps you in range to punish her after she commits E (Hookshot), since she has no mobility left once she's used it

situational.when: she builds into heavy crit or lifesteal and her autos are doing most of the work
the game stretches long and you need more sustain to out-tank her burst windows
their team adds mixed damage sources beyond Camille and you need omni-resistance
the lane stays even and you can safely stack health over a longer game

runes.keystoneWhy: The burst attack-speed window lets you fire all three Vorpal Spikes procs through your autos before Camille's Adaptive Defenses shield fully soaks the exchange, matching the even, auto-trade-heavy nature of this lane.

summoners.why: This pairing has the highest measured win rate in the matchup at 55.2% — Ignite punishes the heal from the outer half of her W (Tactical Sweep) and secures kills during her short all-in windows around her level-6, -11, and -16 R spikes.

playing.title: Hold Q for her E commitment
playing.detail: Her Hookshot knocks up whoever she lands near on a wall, but once she's airborne she has zero mobility left. Punish the landing with Q (Rupture) rather than trying to stop the jump itself.

playing.title: Step past her W's outer band
playing.detail: Tactical Sweep only slows, extra-damages, and heals her in the outer half of its cone. Closing distance fast through that band means you eat the base cone damage without feeding her sustain.

playing.title: Silence through her R anchor
playing.detail: When The Hextech Ultimatum locks you in place, W (Feral Scream) silences her so she can't recast Precision Protocol for its delayed bonus damage, cutting a large chunk out of her combo.

playing.title: Watch for her held empowered auto
playing.detail: Precision Protocol's recast does significantly more damage if she delays it. If she's clearly sitting on the empowered hit, disengage from minion trades until it's used or expires.

playing.title: Auto constantly in melee range
playing.detail: Vorpal Spikes fires on a 0.5s cooldown every attack, so simply staying in auto range during any trade stacks chip damage she can't itemize around.

playing.title: Save Feast for overextensions
playing.detail: R (Feast) deals true damage that ignores her Adaptive Defenses shield entirely — hold it for the moment she overcommits after both her E and R are down.

playing.title: Last-hit through Carnivore to hold lane
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup is to poke from range and use your passive's health/mana return from kills to control the wave state rather than all-in early.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, boots, runes, and summoner picks above are pulled directly from measured games on the current patch (16.20.1); the mechanical reasoning — which cooldowns matter, when to trade, when to silence — is my own tactical read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with her (E). Poke from afar and use your [P] to manage your health to gain control over lane.
